blurb: Congruences, primitive roots, quadratic reciprocity, arithmetic functions, the primes, Pell's equation and RSA.

pics.alt: Title page of Gauss's Disquisitiones Arithmeticae, Leipzig 1801
pics.caption: Title page of Carl Friedrich Gauss's Disquisitiones Arithmeticae (Leipzig, 1801). The book introduced congruence notation and gave the first complete proof of quadratic reciprocity.
pics.title: Disqvisitiones-800.jpg

pics.caption: Pierre de Fermat (1601–1665), a lawyer in Toulouse, stated the little theorem, the two-square theorem for primes p ≡ 1 (mod 4) and his famous Last Theorem, and posed the challenge x² − 61y² = 1.
pics.title: Pierre de Fermat.jpg
